flashcard_questions.q: A broad, long-term goal that a business wants to achieve, such as growth or survival.
A specific, measurable target set by a business to help it achieve its aims.
When a business generates enough revenue to cover its costs and continue trading.

flashcard_questions.a: Total revenue minus total costs. The money a business keeps after paying all its expenses.
The percentage of total sales in a market that is held by one business.
